newsitem.title: HONG KONG: All Pantronic renamed United Pacific Ind.
newsitem.headline: All Pantronic renamed United Pacific Ind.

text.p: All Pantronic Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had changed its name to United Pacific Industries Ltd, effective immediately.
It also unveiled a new corporate logo that the company said would reflect the group's expanded business focus.
"The new logo is designed to show United Pacific Industries' intention to become a bold international industrial group," chairman Ho Che Kong said in a statement.
United Pacific makes voltage converters, coils, rechargeable batteries and telecommunications equipment.
